newsitem.title: USA: Texas/w Okla fed cattle market slow $68 - USDA.
newsitem.headline: Texas/w Okla fed cattle market slow $68 - USDA.

text.p: Trade was slow in the Panhandle area early Friday, USDA said. Limited test slaughter steers and heifers steady. Feedlots reporting limited inquiry from buyers. Sales reported on 1,200 slaughter steers and 100 heifers following the weekly movement of 104,500 head.
Note - all cattle prices based on net weights FOB the feedlot after a 4 percent shrink.
Slaughter Steers - Select and Choice 2-3 1100-1250 lbs 68.00. Pen Select, few Choice 2-3 1200 lbs 67.25.
Slaughter Heifers - Small pen Select and Choice 2-3 1000-1150 lbs 68.00.
